name: Priya N.
text: Genuinely tastes homemade. The butter chicken and garlic naan are now a Friday night staple in our house.

name: James Whitfield
text: Ordered for a dinner party and everyone asked where I'd bought it from. Collection was quick and the food was piping hot.

name: Aisha Rahman
text: The dal makhani is the best I've had outside of my nan's kitchen. Portions are generous and very reasonably priced.

name: Tom Hargreaves
text: Easy to order on WhatsApp and always ready on time for collection. The lamb rogan josh has real depth of flavour.

name: Sunita Patel
text: Finally a local place that makes proper vegetarian food, not just an afterthought on the menu. The paneer tikka is superb.

name: Dave Morrison
text: Ordered delivery for the first time last week, will absolutely be a regular now. Fresh, fragrant, and clearly made with care.
